verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair axis for a developer tool like Terraform, but direct probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown docs variant (HTTP 404) on developer.hashicorp.com. The official MCP server, which feeds registry provider documentation to AI models, is a separate MCP-server capability, not an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs surface, so it is not credited here.
